muted-foreground.displayName: Harbor Mist Text / Faint Signal Text

display.purpose: Hero name only, one instance per page.

title.purpose: Card-level headings (experience role, card primary line).

label.purpose: Eyebrow text, category headers, badges — paired with accent or muted-foreground.

shadows.name: hero-portrait
shadows.purpose: The single deliberate shadow in the system — lifts the hero portrait frame only.

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: Section and card entrance as the visitor scrolls to them.

motion.name: hero-blob-drift
motion.value: scale [1,1.15,1], opacity [0.5,0.8,0.5], duration 10-12s, repeat Infinity, ease easeInOut
motion.purpose: Ambient background motion behind the hero, the only continuous/looping animation in the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid accent CTA — used once per section at most (e.g. hero 'Download CV').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0e7490; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e7490; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline CTA — paired next to a primary button (e.g. 'Contact me').
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #0e7490; color: #0e7490; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e7490; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Skill Chip
components.description: Small pill tag for a skill/technology name; inverts to solid accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #eef2f6; color: #0f172a; font-size: 14px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #0e7490; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Generic bordered container used for skill categories, hobbies, contact links.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #0e7490; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 16px; color: #475569; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Sticky-nav anchor link with active/inactive/hover states driven by scroll position.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { background: none; border: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; color: #475569; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #0f172a; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #0e7490; }

narrative.overview:
The system reads as a calm, deep-navy harbor at night with a single cyan beacon cutting through it. Nearly every surface sits in a narrow band of navy-to-slate neutrals; the one saturated color in the entire palette — Beacon Cyan — is spent deliberately, on the handful of moments that should catch the eye: the active nav link, a primary button, an icon, a category label. Waves (literal inline SVG dividers) recur between sections, a direct nod to the harbor metaphor and to Jorge's own "Team Leader" positioning: someone who guides, doesn't just build.

The system is confident and precise rather than decorative. Structure comes from 1px borders and background-tone contrast, not shadows — depth is earned, not applied by default. Motion is purposeful and restrained: sections fade and lift into place once as the visitor scrolls past them, never on a loop, and the hero's ambient blob drift is the only continuous animation in the system.

Light and dark are equally first-class — the palette was designed dark-first (it's most itself at night) but every token ships as a matched pair, and nothing about the system assumes one mode is "default."
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (Beacon Cyan), spent rarely, never as a fill for large areas.
Flat by default; exactly one deliberate shadow in the whole system (the hero portrait frame).
Two radius families only: fully-rounded pills for anything interactive, 16px for content cards.
A single typeface (Inter) carries display, body, and label roles — hierarchy comes from size/weight, not a second family.
Wave dividers are the system's one recurring decorative signature.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Beacon Cyan appears on nav highlights, one button per view, icons, and labels — never as a background fill larger than a chip. If a design needs "more color," reach for surface/surface-muted contrast, not more cyan.

rules.name: The Paired Palette Rule
rules.body: Every token ships as a light/dark pair that swaps together via the .dark class. Never hand-pick just one half of a pair for a new component.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Inter carries every role. A second typeface is never introduced for "personality" — personality comes from color and motion instead.

rules.name: The Alternating Tide Rule
rules.body: Consecutive sections alternate between background and surface tone. This is the only seam between sections other than the wave dividers — there is never a hard border between two stacked sections.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Exactly one shadow exists in the system: a soft shadow-xl on the hero's circular portrait frame. It is not a pattern to extend to cards, buttons, or anything else.

rules.name: The Pill-or-Panel Rule
rules.body: Every interactive or atomic element is fully rounded (pill/circle). Every content container uses one consistent 16px radius. No other radius value is used anywhere.

dos: Do spend Beacon Cyan rarely and deliberately — one nav highlight, one primary action, an icon, a label.
Do alternate background/surface tone section-by-section instead of adding a divider line between sections.
Do use pill radius for anything a visitor clicks or toggles, and the 16px card radius for anything a visitor reads inside.
Do keep all motion purposeful and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a second shadow anywhere.
Don't use Beacon Cyan as a background fill for anything larger than a chip or button.
Don't put a solid border between two stacked sections.
